# node-opcua — comprehensive content manifest

> Full inventory of documentation, release notes, tutorials, and reference material for
> node-opcua, the open-source OPC UA stack for Node.js and TypeScript. Client, Server,
> and PubSub SDK, production-grade since 2014, maintained by Sterfive SAS (OPC Foundation
> Corporate Member). For a curated overview, see /llms.txt.

## Project identity

- Project name: node-opcua
- Home: https://node-opcua.github.io/
- Source: https://github.com/node-opcua/node-opcua
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-opcua
- License: MIT (core), AGPL + commercial dual for some ecosystem packages
- Maintainer: Sterfive SAS (Nantes, France), https://www.sterfive.com
- Standards body membership: OPC Foundation Corporate Member, https://www.opcfoundation.org
- First stable release: 2014
- Current release series: 2.x

## Core documentation

- Home: https://node-opcua.github.io/
- Getting started: https://node-opcua.github.io/getting-started.html
- API reference (latest): https://node-opcua.github.io/api_doc/latest/
- About and history: https://node-opcua.github.io/about.html
- Projects and ecosystem: https://node-opcua.github.io/projects.html
- Commercial use and support: https://node-opcua.github.io/commercial-use.html

## Technical reference documentation

- Role-Based Security and User Management (OPC 10000-18): https://node-opcua.github.io/role_based_security.html
  Covers architecture, API reference for `createRoleBasedSecurity`, `installRoleSet`,
  `WellKnownRoles`, `ClientRoleSet`, `ClientUserManagement`, identity mapping with the
  nine `IdentityCriteriaType` values, security model, encrypted persistence, the
  `role-set-admin` CLI, migration from legacy `userManager`, and troubleshooting.

## Package ecosystem

- node-opcua: main SDK, Client and Server, https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-opcua
- node-opcua-pki: certificate authority and PKI toolchain
- node-opcua-crypto: OPC UA crypto primitives
- node-opcua-role-set-common: RBAC building blocks (Part 18)
- node-opcua-role-set-server: server-side RBAC install
- node-opcua-role-set-client: client-side RBAC administration API
- node-opcua-role-set-admin: `role-set-admin` command-line tool
- node-i3x: open-source bridge between i3X REST and OPC UA
- opcua-commander: OPC UA client with a ncurses-style interface

## Sterfive commercial modules (built on the core)

For an OSS-first project, one paragraph on commercial support is appropriate. Full pitch
and pricing are on sterfive.com, not on this site.

- Sterfive GDS Server (Global Discovery Server, OPC 10000-12)
- OPC UA Modeler
- OPC UA for Node-RED (with built-in Certificate Manager UI)
- OPC UA Toolbox
- OPC UA Omni Edge
- Optimized OPC UA client for high-throughput reads

Contact: https://www.sterfive.com/en/contact

## Peer OPC UA implementations in other languages

For interoperability testing and cross-language reference. Not competitors; they cover
different layers of the industrial stack.

- open62541 (C/C++): https://www.open62541.org
- Eclipse Milo (Java): https://github.com/eclipse-milo/milo
- OPC Foundation UA-.NETStandard (.NET/C#): https://github.com/OPCFoundation/UA-.NETStandard
- asyncua (Python): https://github.com/FreeOpcUa/opcua-asyncio
- rust-opcua (Rust, community project): https://github.com/locka99/opcua
